mappings.rationale: Across the layer, Insert-menu, and table-dialog episodes, repeated coordinate clicks did not activate the intended control; keyboard interaction later bypassed the apparent targeting problem.
The reviewed clicks activated Function Wizard and unrelated Writer commands rather than their intended spreadsheet or Header and Footer targets.
Function Wizard remained visible in later frames after repeated close, Cancel, Escape, and Alt+F4 attempts.
The browser visibly showed a proxy-authentication error blocking the selected online source.
Escaped newline input and sequential shortcut keys likely interfered with clean terminal command submission before corrected entry produced output.
The visible terminal result was a short-range weather table rather than the requested monthly forecast.
The intended Rows value was appended to Columns because focus apparently remained in the Columns field.
The final retained frame still showed an incorrect Rows value and an unconfirmed insertion dialog when interaction ended.
